integrity: A self-contained proof and standard-library finite verifier are included. The finite tests are corroboration, not a proof for all parameters. Searches cannot establish global uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Only odd 3<=m<2^n and n>=3. Relies on previously published exact Apéry/genus and embedding-dimension results; the quantitative lower bound is not sharp. The arbitrary-parameter inequality is a consequence of known structural formulas, not a claim of a new Apéry formula. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: A uniform quantitative Wilf inequality for Proth numerical semigroups
